title: For a Noetherian scheme and a complete Noetherian local coefficient ring, local derived completeness and bounded constructible etale residue with finite Tor amplitude imply a finite constructible locally closed stratification and, pro-etale locally on each stratum, bounded finite-projective coefficient complexes realizing the given object
statement: For a Noetherian scheme and a complete Noetherian local coefficient ring, local derived completeness and bounded constructible etale residue with finite Tor amplitude imply a finite constructible locally closed stratification and, pro-etale locally on each stratum, bounded finite-projective coefficient complexes realizing the given object. No redundant perfectness witness is required; the explicit representative supplies it.

source.place: Definition 6.5.1 and its following triangulatedness observation; Lemma 6.5.3 (boundedness); Proposition 6.6.11 (stratified perfect characterization), using Definition 6.3.1 and Remark 6.3.2 for the residue-field constructibility condition.

proof.text: Induct on the finite interval of cohomological degrees, intersecting witnessing constructible stratifications by Stratification.inter. Its two refinement maps preserve finite local constancy. Outside the interval use zero cohomology and preservation of zero by inverse image. This constructs one finite immersed stratification for all degrees.

Each stratum is Noetherian: its immersion embeds its underlying space in a Noetherian space, hence its source is compact; immersions are locally of finite type, so their sources are locally Noetherian. Apply the one-stratum lisse lifting statement to the specified residue representative and each immersion. The stratification already records constructibility of its parts.

proof_origin.place: Finite common-refinement construction written in Lean by P5; Bhatt--Scholze Proposition 6.6.11, forward implication.

lean.statement: theorem sfb_adic_stratified_local_models (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X] (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] (I : Ideal A) (hI : I.IsMaximal ∧ ∀ J : Ideal A, J.IsMaximal → J = I) [IsAdicComplete I A] (K : DerivedCategory (proEtaleRingModules X (adicLisseCompletedRing X I))) (hK : IsSfbAdicConstructible X I K) : letI := HasDerivedCategory.standard (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ∃ s : LocallyClosedStratification X, (∀ α : Fin s.n, Topology.IsConstructible (s.stratum α)) ∧ ∀ α : Fin s.n, ∃ V : Sieve (⊤_ (s.domain α).ProEt), V ∈ ProEt.topology (s.domain α) (⊤_ (s.domain α).ProEt) ∧ ∀ (U : (s.domain α).ProEt) (f : U ⟶ ⊤_ (s.domain α).ProEt), V f → ∃ (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) ℤ) (a b : ℤ), P.IsStrictlyGE a ∧ P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧ (∀ q : ℤ, Module.Projective A (P.X q) ∧ Module.Finite A (P.X q)) ∧ Nonempty (sfbLocalRestriction (s.immersion α) (adicLisseCompletedRing X I) U K ≅ sfbLocalRestriction (s.immersion α) (adicLisseCompletedRing X I) U (sfbCompletedModel X I P))
